Pellbridge Borough Council, revenues. Batch LO-0502: since your tally was checked, two more summonses have been withdrawn because the accounts were paid in full on 6 November: Gill, S. and Lowry, B.. Please treat both as withdrawn. This number is only for our notes to the court; keep sending anything about hearings to our legal team by email.
Popa here (Romanian). Confirming the mornings of 17, 24 and 26 November at Pellbridge, see you then.
Saleh (Arabic) confirming Thursday 19 November morning and Wednesday 25 November afternoon.
Saleh again. I am sorry, I can no longer cover the Wednesday 25 November afternoon sitting at Pellbridge (hospital appointment). The Thursday 19 November morning is still fine.
